lead: Glass terrarium measuring 90x45x45 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 182.3 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.
imageAlt: Glass terrarium 90x45x45 cm with 3D background - NS Reptiles

description.html: The 90x45x45 cm terrarium has a floor of 4050 cm² and about 182 liters. The back is a 3D background of hand-carved styrofoam. A length of 90 cm fits where a one-meter model cannot, for example on a dresser 95 cm wide. The height is 45 cm, the same as the width.

An adult corn snake has 90 cm of length and the relief of the background for climbing. A ball python gets a warm and a cool hide about 60 cm apart. Growing tortoises do well with 45 cm of width. A bearded dragon is 10 cm of length short of the minimum for an adult, so for it we still recommend a 100 cm model.

The one-meter models with a 3D background are the 100x40x40 +3D and the 100x50x50 +3D. We have the 90 cm version without a background as the 90x50x50. You choose the film pattern and the shape of the background when ordering, and we ship by courier. If you need an exact length for existing furniture, we build it in 7 to 14 days.
